sources.title: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 - Together AI
sources.snippet: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 is NVIDIA's 600-million-parameter multilingual speech-to-text model designed for high-throughput transcription across EU official languages. Built on FastConformer-TDT architecture and trained on NVIDIA's Granary dataset (670,000+ hours of audio), the model automatically detects the input language and transcribes without additional prompting.
